contracts.fallback: report the URL as text instead of opening it
omit transient notifications when tuiToast is unavailable; tool results remain available

fields.label: Space isolation
fields.hint: Use a temporary isolated profile; off keeps the persistent login profile.

hintTitles.en: Use a temporary isolated profile; off keeps the persistent login profile.
hintTitles.zh: 使用临时隔离空间；关闭时使用持久化登录配置。

fields.label: Idle auto-stop (minutes)
fields.hint: Stop the browser after N minutes without tool calls; 0 disables. Watching is not activity.

hintTitles.en: Stop the browser after N minutes without tool calls; 0 disables. Watching is not activity.
hintTitles.zh: N 分钟没有工具调用后关闭浏览器；0 表示关闭回收。观看不算活动。

fields.label: Resident executor
fields.hint: Reuse the execution process; default off.

hintTitles.en: Reuse the execution process; default off.
hintTitles.zh: 复用执行进程；默认关闭。

fields.label: Resident idle stop (minutes)
fields.hint: Stop the resident executor after N idle minutes; 0 keeps it until unload.

hintTitles.en: Stop the resident executor after N idle minutes; 0 keeps it until unload.
hintTitles.zh: 空闲 N 分钟后停止常驻执行进程；0 表示保留到卸载。

fields.label: Disable live preview frames
fields.hint: No watch panel frames, no screencast capture and no cast worker. Handy in TUI/headless setups. ego_* tools keep working.

hintTitles.en: No watch panel frames, no screencast capture and no cast worker. Handy in TUI/headless setups. ego_* tools keep working.
hintTitles.zh: 不传输观察窗画面、不做 screencast 采集、不启动 cast worker；适合 TUI/无头环境，ego_* 工具不受影响。

fields.label: Runtime script (egoBin)
fields.hint: Node-executable script (.mjs/.js); NOT the official ego-browser.exe. Empty = bundled runtime.

hintTitles.en: Node-executable script (.mjs/.js); NOT the official ego-browser.exe. Empty = bundled runtime.
hintTitles.zh: Node 可执行脚本（.mjs/.js），不是官方 ego-browser.exe；留空使用内置运行时。

fields.label: Browser binary path
fields.hint: Path to Chrome, Chromium or Edge. Empty means auto-detect.

hintTitles.en: Path to Chrome, Chromium or Edge. Empty means auto-detect.
hintTitles.zh: Chrome、Chromium 或 Edge 路径；留空自动检测。

fields.label: Capture backend
fields.hint: Choose automatic detection, CDP or FFmpeg.

hintTitles.en: Choose automatic detection, CDP or FFmpeg.
hintTitles.zh: 选择自动检测、CDP 或 FFmpeg。

fields.label: Quality profile
fields.hint: Low reduces bandwidth; balanced is the default; high improves detail.

hintTitles.en: Low reduces bandwidth; balanced is the default; high improves detail.
hintTitles.zh: 低画质减少带宽；均衡为默认；高画质保留更多细节。

fields.label: FFmpeg binary path
fields.hint: Path to FFmpeg. Empty means auto-detect or on-demand installation.

hintTitles.en: Path to FFmpeg. Empty means auto-detect or on-demand installation.
hintTitles.zh: FFmpeg 路径；留空自动检测或按需安装。

fields.label: Auto-open TUI browser panel

titles.zh: 自动打开 TUI 浏览器面板

fields.hint: Off by default. Open the panel on the first ego_* call; otherwise show a badge and status only.

hintTitles.en: Off by default. Open the panel on the first ego_* call; otherwise show a badge and status only.
hintTitles.zh: 默认关闭。开启后首次 ego_* 调用打开面板；关闭时仅显示角标和状态。
